So, in the event that I had a nephew whose DNA was traced to a crime, and if the police determined through this service that that nephew was related to me, then they could determine who I am by contacting my other relative who is known to 23andMe and try to find out who I am. So even if the users of the service do try to cover their tracks, it can still be thwarted by the acts of other people whom they are related to.
